tactics: obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := List.mergeSort_cons (le := fun a b => le a b) (by simpa using trans) (by intro a b h; simpa using (total a b).resolve_left (by simpa using h)) a l
have hs := List.sorted_mergeSort (le := le) (by simpa using trans) (by simpa using total) (a :: l)
have hm : a ∈ (a :: l).mergeSort le := List.mem_mergeSort.mpr (List.mem_cons_self)
